      TRUST IS A TESTABLE CLAIM.

      Don't take our word for it.

      We hide a real chain's stores in a city it already operates in. Twin Block predicts where they are using only the taste of places near the chain's stores in another city: never the brand, never its stores. Then we reveal the real stores.
